Mejiro Ryan fought hard in the Arima 
Kinen, but she couldn't match Oguri Cap.

However, she acknowledged Mejiro Ryan's 
strength and promised to face her once 
more on this very stage next year.

Etching the experience from this race into 
her heart, Mejiro Ryan sets her sights on 
the Tenno Sho (Spring) for a rematch with 
Mejiro McQueen!
